cohort: The study included 26 children with severe allergic diseases (atopic dermatitis and/or respiratory diseases) who received home-based environmental counseling.
finding: Home-based environmental counseling significantly decreased the SCORAD index in children with atopic dermatitis and increased FEV1 and FVC values in children with respiratory diseases, while IgE and eosinophil values showed slight decreases.
followup_time: N/A (measurements were taken pre- and post-intervention, but the specific duration between these points is not mentioned)
